title: Database Security
summary: Database security layers: least-privilege accounts (apps get SELECT/INSERT only, never DROP), encrypted connections (TLS), hashed passwords

sections.content: Database security layers: least-privilege accounts (apps get SELECT/INSERT only, never DROP), encrypted connections (TLS), hashed passwords (never plaintext), and audit logging.
SQL injection remains the top breach vector — parameterized queries/prepared statements are non-negotiable. Backups need testing: an untested backup is not a backup.
Key points: separate read/write credentials, rotate secrets, encrypt sensitive columns (PII), and restrict network access to the DB port.
